title: Center with translate
summary: top: 50% and left: 50% put the corner at the center; translate(-50%, -50%) pulls it back.
explanation: An absolutely positioned box is placed by its top-left corner. top: 50% and left: 50% therefore put that corner at the middle of the stage, not the box's own middle.
translate(-50%, -50%) then moves the box back by half of its own width and height. Percentages in a translate refer to the element itself, which is what makes this work for a box of any size.
A transform changes only where the box is painted; it takes no part in layout. It also makes the element the containing block for any absolute or fixed descendants, which can surprise you later.
tryThis: Delete the transform line: the box's corner sits at the center.
Add rotate(8deg) after translate(-50%, -50%): it still turns around its own center.
Remove position: relative from .stage: the box centers on the whole preview instead.
